title: damnacanthus biflorus
intro: Damnacanthus biflorus, commonly known as Korean fire-pistil or fire-pistil plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asia, where it is valued for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Damnacanthus biflorus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions, making it a popular ingredient in traditional remedies.
